basic_info.description: Contemporary. Iconic. Urban living redefined.    Welcome to Yerba Buena Lofts, an architectural standout by renowned designer Stanley Saitowitz. This stylish 1-bedroom residence features soaring two-story, floor-to-ceiling windows, exposed concrete accents, and a private patio overlooking the charming, alley-like Shipley Street perfect for soaking in city vibes with a hint of calm. Enjoy a dramatic, light-filled living space with high-end finishes, a custom walk-in closet, in-unit washer/dryer, and 1.5 baths. Deeded parking is conveniently located on the same level, and HOA dues stay low while still covering 24/7 security and concierge service.    All of this is just steps from Whole Foods, SFMOMA, Oracle Park, Caltrain, Union Square, and some of the city's best restaurants.    This is modern San Francisco living with soul.
